name: First Responder's Bible
title: First Responder's Bible
sub: For Police Officers, Firefighters, EMTs, Paramedics, Dispatchers, Nurses, and Search and Rescue

hook.h2: He was not in the wind, the earthquake, or the fire
hook.text: Our Father said, "Go out and stand on the mountain before me; I am about to pass by." A great, powerful wind tore into the mountains and shattered rocks before our Father, but he was not in the wind. After the wind an earthquake, but he was not in the earthquake.
father: "Go out and stand on the mountain before me; I am about to pass by."
hook.note: Elijah had just called fire down in front of a nation, and a day later he was finished — in the desert, asking to die. Our Father fed him and let him sleep before He said a word. Then He put him on the mountain and went past in wind, earthquake and fire, and was in none of them. He came in the whisper after. If your work is sirens and adrenaline, that is worth knowing: He is not in the noise, and He does not need you at full strength to speak to you.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

A day after the greatest moment of his life, Elijah was empty in the desert. Our Father sent food and sleep before He sent words, and when He spoke it was a low whisper, not the fire. He knows what the work costs.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive The Father. Hear His Voice. His Heart Is For You.
body: The First Responder's Bible is a color coded Bible for police officers, firefighters, emts and paramedics — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.

long.h: You Go Toward What Everyone Else Runs From. Your Father Meets You When The Call Is Over.
body: Elijah had just seen fire fall on Carmel, and a day later he was under a broom tree in the desert with nothing left. Our Father did not lecture him. He sent food and sleep first, and only then spoke. "Get up and eat—the journey is too much for you." — 1 Kings 19:7

He came in a low whisper, not in the fire. Your Father knows what the work costs you, and He speaks to you anyway. It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the First Responder's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — in a cover made for the service, opening with pages written for someone who goes toward what everyone else runs from. Those pages sit with Elijah after Carmel, and carry passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance chosen for first responders. From Genesis 1:1 on, it is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Who is it for — is it only for police officers?
faq.a: It is for the whole service: police officers, firefighters, EMTs, paramedics, dispatchers, nurses, and search and rescue. The opening pages speak to the shift and what it costs, not to one uniform, and nothing else in the book is specific to a role.

faq.q: Is it small enough to carry on duty?
faq.a: It is a complete Bible, so it is a substantial book: 6 x 9, hardcover, 876 pages. It is made to live at home, in a locker or in a station day room rather than in a pocket. If you want Scripture on shift, the whole translation is free to read on your phone at fathersheartbible.com/read, with English also free to listen to.

faq.q: Does it have anything on trauma, stress, or PTSD?
faq.a: What it gives you is our Father's own voice, and He speaks straight into what you carry: near to the brokenhearted, saving those crushed in spirit, in His own words in BLUE on the page. The opening pages were written for a first responder, and the notes serve the reader through the text rather than functioning as a counseling guide. His voice is the thing that reaches what a debrief cannot.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for an academy graduation or retirement?
faq.a: It is. There is a presentation page for the name, the giver and the date, and a full color hardcover in case laminate makes a keepsake — a complete Bible rather than a plaque.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
